subject: SPEC: 3rd wrong attempt auto-hint rescue in exam.html
body:
SPEC: Wrong answer 3rd attempt auto-hint in exam.html

FEATURE: When Kai gets the same question wrong 3 times, auto-expand hint layer 1 and surface solution steps.

DATA
Add attempt counter object outside gradeExam: var attemptCounts = {}
On each gradeExam call, for each wrong question: attemptCounts[q.id] = (attemptCounts[q.id]||0)+1
After grading, for any question where attemptCounts[q.id] >= 3: call triggerRescue(q.id)

triggerRescue(qId):
  1. Show hint layers div: document.getElementById('hints-'+qId).style.display = ''
  2. Show hint layer 1: document.getElementById('hint-'+qId+'-1').style.display = ''
  3. Show hint button 2 (show answer): document.getElementById('hintBtn-'+qId+'-2').style.display = ''
  4. Show hint button 3 (solution steps): document.getElementById('hintBtn-'+qId+'-3').style.display = ''
  5. Update feedback div: 'Off target. Check the hint below.'
  6. Scroll to hint layer: document.getElementById('hints-'+qId).scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'})
  7. Reduced motion fallback: if prefers-reduced-motion, use scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant'})

ATTEMPT COUNTER PERSISTENCE
attemptCounts resets when exam.html loads (per-session, not persisted). Intentional.
On reload, autosave restores inputs but not attempt counts. Kai gets a fresh count.

ACCEPT CRITERIA
- 3 wrong on Q3: hints auto-show on Q3, no other questions affected
- 2 wrong then 1 right on Q5: no auto-hint (counter resets is NOT needed - counter never decrements, but correct answer means Kai moved on)
- After auto-hint: grading still works. Submit still works.
- Attempt count visible to Marcus via console.log in dev mode (optional, low priority)
- mobile: scroll to hint is visible without requiring manual scroll
